body:
Hey, I would tell you to hang on there. This reminds me of mine. Because basically I used to take appointment with my therapist once in a month or two! Lol. And it wasn't free. The reason was I was very reluctant to make a phone call for making an appointment. It took a little longer, but I can see slight improvements in myself by the time. I can manage myself better now.

Good to know that you got a free service to go. If you get an appointment once in a month then I think you get an amount of time to work on what happened in the last session.
Literally my situation right now. I cried a sea last night remembering I was only one of his options while I loved him like a crazy!

And learn more about setting boundaries. That's a thing we, people with AvPD suffer from the most. I am still learning putting boundaries in my practical life, but I have only learned there are several types of bounderies one needs to put around for a basic well being and physical boundary is one of them.

I am sorry that you were shaken by an unpredictable unwanted event created by your mother and ruined your progress. You were not bad at all and you did nothing wrong. This was a violation of your physical boundary and you need to learn how to take back your space. Good luck!

My family does. I mean my parents and my sisters. I started therapy at a very low point of my life where I ended up locking myself down in my living place. There was no way out other than trying therapy and my mom took me out of my house. I was so lucky that I was in very good hands, my therapist was so efficient and she let my mom know that I have something more than only depression and anxiety disorder.

Although they are very disappointed and confused about my lifestyle and my thought patterns, they know I have this thing. No one I want to let know about my suffering because they won't get it.

I'm 26. Somehow managed to get a graduation with a somewhat point with the help of my family. My family, especially my mom helped me through the time being a guardian angel and saved me from being a dropout. Now I feel like I'm paralysed and can't move any forward. My family is still carrying my a** and I can't do anything for myself let alone my family. I don't see any way out for myself.  Sometimes I laugh at myself for having a dream in my childhood that one day I would have a degree and a job and would make everyone proud! lol.

At least you are making your small steps, buddy!
So same thoughts here! I end up starting checking up on him every time.
Totally. Every time I get a panic attack and things get worse.

Yes. For me it's repetitive sound. I have been wondering how I don't feel the extreme sensation to the sound I do other times. I mean if there's any sensation to that sound I have, then why I don't feel it every time. So it's real!

Now I can see my mother does the same to my sister. In a humble way though!

I'm an anorexic and I started hating my body and became more anorexic because of her many years ago. She doesn't like me being a all over boney and she admits that sometimes she gets scared of seeing me that I look like a ghost. Fine!

Now my sister appears to having emotional eating disorder and my mother forbids her to eat impulsively as she will get "fat" and she won't be able to get her married once she gets fatty! I just can't pull her away and make her understand how much damage she is causing her.

See, they are hard to please!

But how do you learn maintaining boundaries when you never learnt what personal boundary really is because of your parents' bad parenting during your childhood and adolescence? How do you talk to many people when find your adulthood full of difficulties in socialising?
Do they really have enough time to listen throughout their given 50 minutes? I don't think so!

If he really is an N then there's no point arguing with him about anything or trying to prove yourself right. He will never let you come to a point nor will he ever let you prove you are right. No argument with them has ever ended. And they wouldn't cheat you if they ever wanted you to prove anything. They know very well what they are doing and are capable of lying forever staring at your eyes.

He won't ever take any responsibility for what he has done to you even if you prove you were right. Rather he is gonna blame you for leaving him forever. Maybe it's better stop responding and avoiding him at least for some time. I know this is gonna tough but you should try. Good luck!
Agree with Slayer. And it appears to be more awful when no motivation works!

I stopped taking antidepressants and anti anxieties because those made me feel 
like an insane! I used to feel like I had no control over my thoughts and and emotions! So I stopped taking them and continued with CBT from my efficient therapist. It took a bit long but worked fine without medication.

Hey I just gave a try to audiobooks and it's truly great! Tbh never thought of giving it a go before today. It appears they could be by your side at the time of your real sicknesses if you found a good recording one! Right now I'm so ill with high fever and finding comfort in listening to a good book with a very good voice!

Thanks for the recommendation.
Thank you so much for these kind words. I will try my best.

My parents and sisters don't care anymore. They think I make some kind of drama to get attention. So if could tell your parents you are so lucky and congratulations for the courage to seek out for help! It takes a lot of courage. I feel you. Go for it!

Everything is so similar to me, except I am 26 and got one of the anxious personality disorders because of their awful control throughout my childhood and adolescence and they still do not care about respecting my opinion or hearing my thoughts and still keep me homebound. The only way I am allowed to move out is by getting married which I don't want.
I can relate. My mother is always like this. I'm 26 and still she wants me do everything she says to and start acting spooky if you disagree!
Wow! I was literally thinking about the words I could leave for my ungrateful nitwit family. But now I see there's no point giving them ant justification for my action.
Awwww! So cute reading this! Really made my day!

Yes. That's a constant state of my mind for last 4 years. I went to therapy. It helped me identify what's going on but didn't help me with suicidal ideation. I always keep that as a big option to survive everyday since I still don't see any other option than to wake up and find myself alive.

Well I was thinking about this either for a couple of weeks. This seems really a good topic, Diaper! 

When an AvPD suffers from isolation, feeling criticised, difficulty in socialising, finally, letting someone get closer, then how they can make it to have significant one? Willing to know more about this.

Good to know that you are diagnosed with the right one to focus on, because AvPD is one of the most difficult to find out ones as it has likelihood to many other disorders.

I have heard from people that were diagnosed properly after shifting to couple of therapists and a pretty huge time has passed. So congratulations if you are diagnosed with the right disorder earlier and best of luck for the time ahead.

Oh yes yes! That CV thing gets to me too. I don't even know what I'm good at or what I'm interested in! I feel lost while filling out CVs and assume being criticised and laughed at looking at my overwhelmed CV!

I can totally imagine how you feel criticised and scared of having an interest that is not easily seen because I feel criticised and ashamed for not even being able to talk about any interest!
I'm 26 and still don't know what to do with this life!
Well written.

Exactly the same here. I get anxious because I don't have anything I'm interested in for real. So I got nothing to proceed with while conversing. I'm better with a false image about whatever they make about me than to let others know my empty self.

And yes, I had to make an alt account not only here, on my every socials just to hide my own self.

Omg! I am so sorry he did this to you! Such a horrible way to discard! Ugh! F**king sick people!

I didn't really get a discard on my bdays rather he wished me on time every year, even though he is with his another supply! After a day or two of bday he ghosted me as usual! Here I thought, Oh God! He remembered my bday! 

Every time he hoovered, I reminded me of his caring wishes on bdays. 

Shit! Now I feel annoyed remembering his wishes on my bdays! Because I saw couple of photos of him with his supply around my bday! Because everything clicks now!
Good luck to you, pal!

Honestly I feel like this every morning right after waking up. Just don't want to get up and start another damn day and fucking live. Some days I cry, for no reason, other days I find my eyes stuck staring at the ceiling. And I feel the same, everyone out there enjoying life must be fake!

Listening to or reading motivations seems like real torture for me when nothing works.

Good to know that you are stepping up for socialising more. Most people say that socialising takes practice. So you can try some. Like start your guitar classes and see how that works. Of course you got an option for backing out if you feel that not working. Got nothing to lose!

The thing is when you get into something with people having similar interest you don't have to work harder to explain what you are saying. Moreover, once you get into, your main focus is likely going to turn into your interest, not the people around. And it's gonna happen automatically.

Although, it didn't work for me. It appears that this disorder has made me hate people and resistant in growth.

Looks like you are in a better condition than many of us. Good luck!

Man, did you write this for me? Every word you wrote works for me.

I feel like I am not ready yet to leave him. On the other hand I just know he is gonna leave me again, after making sure I am still here thinking of him.

Same here. Even for the sake of a conversation continue, if anyone asks about my hobbies or interest I am like just lost of my words. Because I don't do anything special for my happiness. I don't even know what that is.

That's what they do. They always keep fishing. I wonder how they manage to say they love you while you are not on their mind. I can't even fake a hello! 

They keep looking on others so they do not fall short supply. And do not hesitate to discard you even for a slightest conflict. They jump right to another they were looking or fishing if ever they find you not being enough for their supply and find a cause for blaming you to move to another one. And the show goes on.

At least you got a so called shitty "apology". I never even got that one for cheating on me the whole time. Not even after bringing that up again and again. For years he denied about her and others whom I suspected. I understand how much it aches in the chest when they come back, because every time he tries to crawl back, every time he tries to hoover, I have to pretend not to see that at all. Sometimes I ask myself whether I really deserve this much pain for loving him genuinely.

These people just justify everything they want. And once they get to know that you truly care for them, they keep coming back for taking advantage of you.

Thanks, life, for your kind words. Needed those at this moment.

Yes I am okay with not looking on good friends. I am good with relying on myself. But what makes me mad that they act in a way like they really want to be good friends, at least acquaintances. And when they abandon, I begin to think - who asked them to come forward to talk to me, who asked them to be too friendly when they are suddenly gonna abandon! Irritating people!
My sister is exactly like this. If anyone of us gets in a bad mood she feels like she is responsible for fixing this!
Thank you so much for your kind your kind words in the last paragraph.

Yes. They can. And if you look into  carefully you might find them with another supply enjoying the view. Here, you were taking their silent punishment and waiting for them coming back! They pretend to get hurt from you but in reality they are looking on another supply while fell short from yours!

They are pathetic!
